copy.tagline: 系统化排查并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复代码中的问题
copy.tagline_en: Systematically diagnose and fix code defects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix issues in code

howto.what: 遇到bug、测试失败或意外行为时，Claude会先调查根本原因，再提出修复方案。它按四个阶段工作：调查原因、分析模式、提出假设并测试、实施修复。
howto.when: 当你报告任何技术问题（如测试失败、生产环境bug、性能问题等）时触发。尤其在你感到时间紧迫、想快速修复、或已尝试多次修复未果时，Claude会强制启动该流程。

say.text: 这个测试一直失败，帮我找出根本原因。
我试了两次修复都没成功，接下来怎么办？

howto.what_en: When encountering bugs, test failures, or unexpected behavior, Claude first investigates root cause before proposing fixes. It follows four phases: root cause investigation, pattern analysis, hypothesis testing, and implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report any technical issue (test failures, production bugs, performance problems, etc.). Especially when under time pressure, tempted to quick-fix, or after multiple failed attempts, Claude enforces this process.

say_en.text: This test keeps failing. Help me find the root cause.
say_en.note: Claude starts Phase 1, reading error messages and reproducing the issue.

say_en.text: I tried two fixes and they didn't work. What now?
